metadata.definition: For each dataset, test points are binned into deciles by realized |Y_t - yhat_t| using shared bins across methods; rows report method-wise empirical coverage/miss rate in each decile.

columns.abs_error_mean: Mean realized absolute point-forecast error in the decile.
columns.coverage: Mean indicator that Y_t is inside the prediction interval.
columns.miss_distance_mean: Mean distance outside the interval, zero for covered points.
columns.width_mean: Mean prediction interval width in the decile.
columns.n_points: Number of pointwise test rows in the dataset/method/decile bin.
